findings.description: The Lambda environment variables contain an AWS access key ID and secret access key in plaintext. Credentials embedded in Terraform and Lambda configuration can be exposed through source control, Terraform state, deployment artifacts, or Lambda configuration read permissions, enabling unauthorized AWS access.
The function uses nodejs12.x, an end-of-life runtime that no longer receives security patches. Known runtime vulnerabilities may remain exploitable in the Lambda execution environment.
